title: Daily Security Intelligence Briefing — September 06, 2026
summary: Active zero-day exploitation targets Adobe Commerce and Magento stores via the StyleSmuggler flaw, while unauthenticated SSH attacks compromise exposed MikroTik routers. JetBrains users face mandatory credential rotations following a TeamCity breach affecting Cadence (The Hacker News, Sansec, CERT Polska).

tier2.title: 1. Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: E-Commerce / Vulnerability Management

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Dutch e-commerce security firm Sansec disclosed an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce dubbed StyleSmuggler. Threat actors began actively exploiting the flaw on September 4 to execute arbitrary code without authentication and install backdoors on e-commerce web servers.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Unpatched zero-day StyleSmuggler allows unauthenticated remote code execution on Adobe Commerce and Magento.; Attackers are actively deploying backdoors on vulnerable e-commerce platforms.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Sansec, which discovered the flaw and named it StyleSmuggler, said attacks started on September 4.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 2. Attackers Hijack MikroTik Routers Through Internet-Exposed SSH Without Authentication

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Network Infrastructure / Access Control

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: CERT Polska issued a warning regarding ongoing attacks targeting internet-exposed SSH remote-access services on MikroTik routers. Attackers are obtaining full administrative control without authenticating, with confirmed malicious activity dating back to at least September 2.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Internet-exposed SSH on MikroTik routers allows attackers to gain admin control without credentials.; Administrators should immediately restrict external access to device management ports.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Attackers are exploiting MikroTik routers with their Secure Shell (SSH) remote-access service, which is reachable from the internet, to gain full administrative control without authentication...

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 3. Attackers Breached JetBrains Cadence via Unpatched TeamCity, Extracting AWS Credentials

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Supply Chain / Credential Compromise

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: JetBrains reported a security breach affecting its Cadence environment following the exploitation of a critical TeamCity vulnerability. Threat actors extracted secrets and credentials, prompting JetBrains to urge all Cadence users to immediately revoke and rotate all associated credentials and secrets.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Unpatched TeamCity flaw was exploited to breach JetBrains Cadence infrastructure.; Users must rotate all secrets and AWS credentials associated with Cadence executions.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: Cadence users should immediately revoke or rotate all credentials and secrets that may have been used to run their Cadence executions...

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 4. Critical VMware Workstation and Fusion Flaw Lets VM Admins Execute Host Code

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Virtualization / Privilege Escalation

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: Broadcom released security patches for an integer-overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-59346, CVSS 9.3) in VMware Workstation and Fusion. The bug enables local attackers with elevated privileges inside a virtual machine to escape guest isolation and execute arbitrary code on the host operating system.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: CVE-2026-59346 allows elevated VM users to escape guest environments to execute code on the host.; Patches are now available across affected VMware Workstation and Fusion releases.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-59346 (CVSS score: 9.3), is an integer-overflow vulnerability that a local attacker with elevated privileges can exploit to run arbitrary code.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: The Hacker News

tier2.title: 5. Over 5,400 Hacked Sites Serve ClickFix Payloads Stored on the Blockchain

fields.label: Domain
fields.value: Web Security / Social Engineering

fields.label: Subject / Topic Summary
fields.value: A large-scale cybercriminal campaign has compromised over 5,400 small-business websites to distribute ClickFix social engineering lures. The attackers are hosting malicious payloads within smart contracts on the BNB Smart Chain (BSC) to bypass traditional web takedown efforts.

fields.label: Key Technical & Strategic Takeaways
fields.value: Threat actors host social engineering payloads inside smart contracts on the BNB Smart Chain.; Over 5,400 compromised websites serve the malicious prompts to site visitors.

fields.label: Essential Direct Quote
fields.value: A massive cybercriminal operation is leveraging thousands of compromised small-business websites to deliver ClickFix payloads stored in smart contracts on the BNB Smart Chain (BSC).

fields.label: Source
fields.value: BleepingComputer
